findings.title: DIRECTIVE-20260701-001 was a zombie: deliverable produced 2026-07-03 but directive stuck status=pending, preempting the dispatcher every run since.
findings.evidence: Audit file monitor/tinker/audits/zombie-directive-audit-2026-07-01.json present (26KB, 23 rows, commit 2033d01 by tinker-2026-07-03T02-40). Directive carried auto_close_when_deliverable_proposed:true but PROP-108 auto-close only reaches directives whose linked PROP has status='proposed'; this directive commissioned an audit FILE, not a PROP, so no mechanism could close it. This is a structural gap: audit-deliverable directives cannot auto-close under the current PROP-108 design.
findings.action_taken: Flipped DIRECTIVE-20260701-001 -> status=completed via clone-and-push (additive lifecycle edit; authorized by CLAUDE.md DIRECTIVE-LIFECYCLE exception and the directive's own 100%-verified-OBE exception clause). auto_applied_by_this_run=true recorded.
findings.recommendation: Structural: PROP-108/directive-auto-close.js should recognise a second close trigger for directives whose deliverable is a FILE (declared path present + non-empty) rather than only a linked proposed-status PROP. Candidate future PROP if the audit-deliverable directive pattern recurs.
